title: The app
body: I’m enjoying the concept of Rise: Life Reset and appreciate the effort put into its design and purpose. However, I’ve noticed that the app tends to lag or freeze occasionally, even though I’m using an iPhone 14 Plus, which should handle it smoothly. I believe optimizing performance would greatly improve the overall experience. Looking forward to future updates—thank you for your work!
